        children: "errorSyncBackendError"
      }), " 映射成 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "SyncFailed"
      }), " 回调（", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "watchersyncer.go:248-253"
      }), "），Felix 据此退回 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "WaitForDatastore"
      }), "。恢复时重新 List：List 拿到新全集后，", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "finishResync"
      }), "（", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "watchercache.go:563"
      }), "）会把「上次缓存里有、这次 List 里没有」的对象作为 Deleted 补发给下游（", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "watchercache.go:577-590"
      }), "）。也就是说，删除以 resync 差量的形式补发，而不是靠 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "SendDeletesOnConnFail"
      }), "（Felix syncer 默认不开启该选项，", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "felixsyncerv1.go"
      }), " 的 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "ResourceType"
      }), " 都没设）。"]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["进程退出 / 上下文取消时，", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "watcherCache"
      }), " 的 ", _jsx(_components.code, {

      }), " 会先对当前缓存里的所有对象发 Deleted（", _jsx(_components.code, {

      }), "，", _jsx(_components.code, {

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h3, {

        children: "Next()"

        children: "sync_server.go:1204-1220"

function MDXContent(props = {}) {
  const {wrapper: MDXLayout} = {
    ..._provideComponents(),
    ...props.components
  };
  return MDXLayout ? _jsx(MDXLayout, {
    ...props,
    children: _jsx(_createMdxContent, {
      ...props
    })
  }) : _createMdxContent(props);
}
return {
  default: MDXContent
};
function _missingMdxReference(id, component) {
  throw new Error("Expected " + (component ? "component" : "object") + " `" + id + "` to be defined: you likely forgot to import, pass, or provide it.");
}
